seeds/seed.js.purpose: MongoDB seed data script for development

package.json.purpose: Node.js dependencies and scripts - must include express, mongoose, dotenv, cors, jsonwebtoken, bcrypt as dependencies, nodemon as devDependency; start and dev scripts must run src/app.js because no server.js or src/index.js is generated

src/app.js.purpose: Express application setup and middleware - imports config, MongoDB database, error handler, and routes/index.js at /api; starts the server with app.listen; imports auth middleware and mounts auth routes before protected module routes

src/config/database.js.purpose: Database connection setup - exports a mongoose connection helper for MongoDB

src/middleware/auth.js.purpose: Authentication middleware - verifies JWT from Authorization header and adds req.user

src/models/inventory.js.purpose: inventory data model - defines and exports a Mongoose schema/model

src/models/posts.js.purpose: posts data model - defines and exports a Mongoose schema/model

package_frontend.json.purpose: Frontend dependencies and scripts â€” must include react, react-dom, react-router-dom, axios, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react

src/services/api.js.purpose: API client configuration using axios â€” uses import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL (Vite convention, not process.env)

src/models/roles.js.purpose: roles data model - defines and exports a Mongoose schema/model

src/models/users.js.purpose: User data model for authentication - defines and exports a Mongoose schema/model

src/routes/auth.js.purpose: Authentication routes (login, register, logout) - uses Mongoose user model, bcrypt for passwords, jwt for tokens

src/routes/index.js.purpose: Route aggregator - imports and mounts exactly the route files listed in depends_on

src/routes/inventory.js.purpose: inventory API routes - uses the inventory model with Mongoose document operations

src/routes/posts.js.purpose: posts API routes - uses the posts model with Mongoose document operations

src/routes/roles.js.purpose: roles API routes - uses the roles model with Mongoose document operations
